item.title: Vue 3 Composition API vs Options API: Which Should You Use in 2026?
item.description: Vue 3 gives you two ways to write components: the Composition API and the Options API. In this post, I break down the differences, the trade-offs, and which one you should actually reach for in 2026.
item.author: Karl Rito

item.title: How I'm Writing This Blog With Comet Browser (And What I've Learned Using It)
